facts.fact: 开头写 Lily 几小时前还不确定能否活到明天，如今却和家人站在跑道上准备登机。
facts.anchor: A few hours ago, Lily hadn’t been sure she’d live to see tomorrow, and now … she was standing on a runway with her family

facts.fact: Nan 揭露目的地是古巴海岸以南的另一家天堂度假村，并称凭关系订到最好的住处。
facts.anchor: “So we’re going to another Paradise resort. This one is farther south, off the coast of Cuba. Thanks to my connections, I’ve reserved the best

facts.fact: Avery 问客人是否都送往那里，Nan 称大多数都被转送到那里。
facts.anchor: “Is that where all the guests are being sent?” Avery asked. “Most of them are being rerouted there,” Nan said.

facts.fact: Milo 向 Lily 道谢，感谢她在探险中做他的朋友并激励他勇敢。
facts.anchor: For being my friend on this quest

facts.fact: Milo 送给 Lily 一颗小小的红宝石，说出自他的旅行收藏、可保平安。
facts.anchor: He pulled his hand out of his pocket and opened his fist. There was a small but beautiful ruby sitting in his palm.

facts.fact: Milo 说岛南端已正式封锁，大家都安全，包括美洲豹。
facts.anchor: that said the southern part of the island is officially sealed off now so thankfully everyone is safe, including the jaguars.

facts.fact: Milo 否认曾联系父亲，因信号塔仍瘫痪无法发出消息，令 Lily 怀疑谁封锁了南区。
facts.anchor: The cell towers were still down. I couldn’t get a message through

facts.fact: 结尾飞机颠簸露出 Nan 的黄色文件夹，标注她是天堂公司的天使投资人，令 Lily 震惊并装睡。
facts.anchor: A yellow folder with the Paradise logo printed on it and a label at the top that read: Penelope Sprague, Angel Investor.
